_note: Task-card id allocation across parallel agents. An id is occupied if it appears on the base ref, in an unmerged local/remote branch (commit message or touched path), in a recent pull request (title/branch/body), or in the shared reservation ledger kept in the git common dir. Reservations must answer with the next free id instead of a bare refusal (INV-ATM-008). pruneMissingWorktreeReservations: a ledger entry whose worktree directory no longer exists is dropped; pushed branches and PRs still occupy the id through their own sources.
